fields.name: req_valid

fields.name: req_id
fields.note: frame_core.request_id is the frame transaction ID. Slot/lane indices are separate domains; epoch must accompany any reset-reused ID.

fields.name: advance_mask

time_bases.cycle: Monotonic actual core posedge count; never infer from 50MHz board clock or frame rows
time_bases.epoch: Initial observed reset entry is0; increment on each independently recorded reset entry; no frame-derived epochs
time_bases.frame_origin_cycle: F: independently scheduled and publicly observed FRAME, not an accepted request
time_bases.request_first_valid_cycle: First PRE_NBA sample with req_valid==1; not its prior NBA transition; source may queue under backpressure
time_bases.accept_cycle: A: actual PRE_NBA req_valid && req_ready; earliest F+1, may be later
time_bases.commit_cycle: Actual pcm_valid && pcm_ready buffer acceptance; distinct from RETURN
time_bases.tx_cycle: Actual frame_start && TX-valid sampling of PRE_NBA play tuple

deadline.return_commit_cleanup: t-F <833 AND t < next_independent_FRAME; no clearing overdue work
deadline.processing_age: Report t-A separately; never replace actual acceptance timestamp by F
deadline.consume: At actual independently scheduled next FRAME, gap833/834 from F; not a late-completion allowance
deadline.statistics_only: max_processing_cycles excludes unfinished/overwritten requests; cannot prove per-ID deadlines

same_edge_priority: Reset asserted: invalidate old epoch; no valid normal handshake/adoption; retain independent asynchronous reset/lock event log
Normal FRAME: TX samples PRE_NBA pending/held tuple; frame rollover updates state by NBA; result/commit ready gates are0
FRAME raw cancel is window control even without a transaction; overdue rollover is a deadline failure, never a fabricated legal cleanup
Non-FRAME: capture all simultaneous PRE_NBA event/req/result/commit/config handshakes atomically; input accept is not allocator apply

tx_sidecar.commit: write pending tuple on same control branch and edge as pending PCM
tx_sidecar.frame: Select old pending if valid, else old held; record actual TX tuple first, then move pending to held
tx_sidecar.startup: zero PCM; no valid request identity; req_id null, never reserve numeric0
tx_sidecar.hold: inherit held tuple, including epoch/id/clip; equal PCM proves no identity
tx_sidecar.tx_frame_id: per-epoch actual TX-adoption ordinal, first0; distinct from request ID
tx_sidecar.overflow: stop capture before cycle/epoch/ordinal ambiguity; preserve actual request ID modulo32 with epoch binding

legacy_D3_projection.REQUEST: Derived frame-budget reservation at F; never label it actual production handshake
legacy_D3_projection.ACCEPT: Actual A retained with raw row link; never shift A to F
legacy_D3_projection.LANE_TICK: Only expand a real common mask1111 into same-cycle diagnostic rows with same source event; no staggered fake ticks
legacy_D3_projection.real_acceptance: Separate new actual-handshake/TX/continuous-frame checks required for G1; old L1 does not certify them

completion.window: Freeze active epoch windows/start/stop before execution, independent of observed FRAME or cancellation
completion.reset_phase: Require reset/lock input event log, known zero accumulator/BCLK/slot and exact first PRE_NBA local-reset-high edge; otherwise PENDING_RESET_PHASE
completion.tail: Declare last required TX adoption and full serial decode boundary in input plan; retain later guard/adoption as UNKNOWN tail, never claim decoded
completion.finish: Match planned stop and actual successful finish, unique MONITOR_END/END, exit0/no-timeout/cleanup receipt; EOF or old END REAL_M1 alone is insufficient
completion.missing_plan: PENDING_FRAME_PLAN; never derive expected frames from observed trace
completion.empty_ledger: Does not end frame coverage; check every planned FRAME after legitimate cancel/idle through stop
